title: The Majin Buu Saga in 5 Minutes (Dragonball Z Live Action)
original_title: The Majin Buu Saga in 5 Minutes (Dragonball Z Live Action)
overview: Mega64 reenacts the entire Majin Buu Saga of the anime Dragon Ball Z (1996) in sweded/homemade fashion under 5 minutes - or in however much time they feel like doing.
